problem: Which US states (do not include Washington DC) had fewer than 100 total fatal car crashes in any year between 2016 and 2019, using NHTSA data?
answer: Alaska, Hawaii, New Hampshire, North Dakota, Rhode Island, South Dakota, and Vermont
